text:
Asha: Quick holiday plan - low-key virtual office toast next Wednesday 4pm PT? Bring a drink (tea, cocoa, whatever) and one 10-second 'shoutout' for someone on the team. :)
Asha: Thinking 20-30 min so it's short and inclusive. We'll record a screenshot collage afterwards for people who can't join.
Marc: love this. can we also thread in a tiny 'kudos' list for remote folks to add so they show up in the collage?
Tess: yes please. i'll add a 2-line template for kudos.
Ben: Template?
Tess: copy/paste: `kudos: <name> - <1 line reason>` e.g., `kudos: SRE - saved the deploy at 2am`
Riley: RSVP: in. can i nominate two people? or one per person?
Asha: nominate as many as you like but keep each kudos to one line. we'll limit shoutouts during the live toast to 1 each so it's speedy.
PayrollBot: Note: if you want a small year-end bonus ping, submit by Dec 20. (This is not the toast, just a friendly reminder.)
Ben: will there be a holiday meme contest too? asking for a friend.
Asha: hah maybe a tiny 'best virtual background' side contest. no prizes except bragging rights and a digital sticker.
Marc: timezone check - that 4pm PT is 7pm ET and 12am UK. remote EMEA folks might be late; can we record and also do a separate mid-day EMEA friendly one if there's interest?
Asha: yup we can do a short recorded collage and a second short meetup if enough people want it. please vote here: 
- Option A: single 4pm PT toast (main)
- Option B: main + 30-min EMEA-friendly repeat next day
Tess: voting: Asha, Marc, Tess, Ben, Riley. My vote: B if more than 3 EMEA folks want it.
Riley: i'll ping our EU folks to check interest.
Ben: tiny logistics: will there be prompts? i.e., say one thing you're proud of from 2025?
Asha: Good idea. Prompt list (pick one):
1) One win you're proud of in 2025
2) One teammate shoutout (1 line)
3) One silly holiday tradition you do
Asha: We'll rotate prompts so it's not all the same.
Marc: also can we do a 'gratitude slide' where people drop gifs or 1-line notes beforehand? i can assemble into a single image.
Tess: i'll start a thread to collect gifs and 1-line notes. Name files like `kudos_name.gif` or paste text directly.
PayrollBot: Reminder scheduled: 1767891955 -> 1767905555 (48h left to RSVP).
Riley: tiny ask: please keep it PG and avoid sharing anything that identifies customers or internal secrets.
Asha: yes Code of Conduct applies. If you want to remain anonymous on a kudos, prefix with `anon:` and i'll anonymize.
Ben: i'll bring the terrible holiday jokes. Prepare your groans.
Marc: for the collage, can we include a small caption under each photo: name + 1-line kudos?
Asha: yep we'll do that. If remote and you want a printed mini-card mailed, DM me and we'll see what we can do.
Tess: added a short doc with format examples and a calendar invite link: https://tiny.redwood/holiday-toast (edit access: org).
Riley: RSVP: submitted. Also uploaded a gif 'riley_dance.gif' for the gratitude slide.
Asha: Nice! Thanks all. I'll post a final reminder on Tuesday AM and pin the doc. Quick and cozy. :evergreen_tree::clinking_glasses:
